plugins.name: agent-sprites
plugins.description: Pixel-art sprite authoring toolset for 2D game projects — parametric shapes, ramp-aware lighting, animation groups, Aseprite JSON atlas export, and a live collaborative web UI. Editable storyboard blocking panels with replayable named shapes, verified PNGs and contact sheets support agent-prose story plans.

plugins.name: agent-draw
plugins.description: Vector-first 2D authoring for coding agents: validated JSON projects become editable SVG with named Inkscape layers, transparent PNG and PDF exports, and build receipts. Three skills: draw-setup, draw-authoring and draw-export. Managed runtime, Node.js 22+ and existing Inkscape 1.2+; no browser or npm dependencies. Linux verified.

plugins.name: agent-meshes
plugins.description: Named-part 3D authoring for coding agents - build rigged, animated GLB models from JSON operations (primitives, lathe and prism profiles, organic shells), creature recipes with walk, trot and gallop gaits and Jansen's Strandbeest linkage, isolated verified builds with renders, contact sheets and offline previews, an embeddable three.js viewer with a scripted puppet API, and an optional Blender refine stage. Five skills: mesh-setup, mesh-authoring, mesh-rigging, mesh-build, mesh-believable

plugins.name: agent-vids
plugins.description: Marketing and training videos of web apps for coding agents - analyse the app, recommend a brief with cited craft rules, storyboard it, and render narrated, captioned, craft-checked video with Playwright capture and ffmpeg; 60 evidence-backed rules for length, calls to action, text size relative to the frame, contrast, captions and narration language, reusable LinkedIn, YouTube and Shorts channel profiles and style flavors, voice auditions, and a LAN review page where the owner picks and orders exhibits and finalizes the stitched video. Repeatable stepped capture for browser games, a Steam trailer channel and lossless store stills. Five skills: vid-setup, vid-discover, vid-brief, vid-storyboard, vid-render

plugins.name: agent-beeps
plugins.description: Procedural sound and music composer for coding agents: game SFX, UI sounds and loopable game music as Web Audio patches and songs, rendered in Chromium, measured (loudness, sharpness, roughness, pitch, loudness arc), linted against cited craft rules, auditioned by the owner on a LAN page, and ranked by a taste model learned from every choice.

plugins.name: agent-prose
plugins.description: Writing-craft toolkit for coding agents: poems and song lyrics, game dialogue and barks, instructions and technical docs, academic and professional prose, screen and stage scripts, YouTube scripts, speeches, professional presentations and webinars. Seventeen skills include slide briefs, speaker notes and rehearsal, webinar run sheets, moderator cues, interaction and demo recovery, plus illustrated storyboards. Native drafts, cited craft checks, voice bibles, variants, owner reviews and learned taste; PDF/HTML reading copies and guarded dialogue source round trips.

plugins.name: agent-engine
plugins.description: Skills for engine selection, Phaser architecture and verification, custom shaders, and importing agent-sprites, agent-meshes and agent-beeps assets into game engines. Includes pixel UI, accessible controls, native text entry and WebGL2/ES3 shader guidance for Phaser.

plugins.name: agent-marketing
plugins.description: Evidence-led marketing for family-made tools, apps and games: audience discovery, channel strategy, paying-demand and non-English market research with sourced decision reports, campaigns, collateral, monitoring, reception and experiment decisions, and game-launch planning with readiness gates and weekly maker-hours checks, with decisions, next steps and collateral picks tracked in the ledger and the desk. Ten skills, a portable evidence ledger, a dependency-free Node CLI and a local campaign desk.

plugins.name: sf-browser-control
plugins.description: Salesforce browser automation via SF CLI - 45+ tools for session management, Lightning navigation, form filling, record operations, and Setup automation

plugins.name: h-superpowers
plugins.description: An agentic skills framework for AI coding assistants - composable workflows for planning, TDD, debugging, and code review

plugins.name: agent-stalker
plugins.description: Track agent team task assignment, messages, and tool use across Claude Code sessions into SQLite with queryable CLI and web dashboard

plugins.name: md-publisher
plugins.description: Turn markdown documents (with embedded mermaid) into themed, searchable, paged PDFs via WeasyPrint AND Microsoft Word DOCX via python-docx. 5 skills (publish with --format pdf|docx|both, preprocess, theme-advisor, theme-gallery with live palette swatches + typography samples, install-fonts) + 6 bundled themes (atlas/phosphor/arcade in light + dark) + interactive custom-theme creation + cross-platform Google Fonts installer + macOS/Linux/Windows native-dep probes via bootstrap --doctor

plugins.name: wiki-master
plugins.description: Maintain a Karpathy-style LLM wiki on Obsidian via the native obsidian CLI - discover and clip web sources, ingest PDFs/DOCX, then query, lint, and relink them into a cross-referenced knowledge vault

plugins.name: academia-fetch
plugins.description: Find papers worth reading via OpenAlex, then retrieve them from academia.edu with your own subscription and stage them for wiki-master ingest - human-paced rather than a crawler, with an enforced per-run delay and ceiling, and an open-access short-circuit that skips the subscription entirely when a paper is legitimately free elsewhere

plugins.name: hartye-skills
plugins.description: General-purpose utility skills for Claude Code - small, self-contained techniques useful across many projects. beautiful: distinctive frontend design that avoids templated, AI-generated aesthetics, covering direction, typography, layout, motion and interface copy. ship-it: commit, branch, push, PR and squash-merge pending work in one step. yoda: write, audit and diagnose skills - why a SKILL.md never fires, gets ignored, or competes with another. rubber-duck: get a second opinion from the other vendor model and record it verbatim

plugins.name: book-nom
plugins.description: Capture printed books into the family wiki - iPhone document scans to wiki-ready markdown via local OCR/VLM routing (Tesseract + Qwen via Ollama), with spread splitting, per-page provenance metadata, selective page images, and an optional guarded polish pass. Human-in-the-loop split calibration: draggable split lines feed the pipeline verbatim and double as detector ground truth. Includes the book-capture skill documenting the scan/calibrate/process/polish/ingest workflow

plugins.name: agent-tests
plugins.description: Test-efficiency toolkit for coding agents: structure tests by project phase and risk, audit a suite for redundant, shim, worktree-hostile, unwired, over-frequent and costly native UI tests, and remediate with evidence.

plugins.name: agent-workflow
plugins.description: Subscription-backed Codex workflows with genuine native worker skill selection, verified tool readiness, immutable capabilities and reviewed artifact handoffs. Durable terminal notifications and a named cursor-based observer preserve failures across reconnects. Authenticated session dashboard; four skills, seven recipes, Node 24+. No custom MCP or API-key fallback. Windows verified; skill roots are selected before worker startup. Explicit opt-in compatibility supports the tested Windows OpenSSH Session 0 context, with shared UI exposure disclosed.
